identification: Fishing lot: 8 boxed Rebel lures (Rebel Naturalized series incl. Brown Trout and Spanish Mackerel jointed minnows, a jointed minnow, fastrac minnow, 1970s-80s boxes); boxed FISHCAKE lure; boxed lure in blue/white 'Humdinger'-type box; boxed Rapala-style balsa minnow; 'ASHLEY' fishing lure on card; Tassie Devil style winged trout lures (5-6, X-pattern); spoons, spinners (Mepps/Celta type), small Cobra-style green trout lures; plastic tackle box. Reels: 5 or 6 1970s fixed-spool spinning reels, incl. Daiwa (reel box 'Daiwa Fishing Reel 72..' with two Daiwa spare spool boxes), a gold Daiwa-style reel, a reel in an 'Intrepid Prince Regent' box (Intrepid, England). Catalogue: estimate A$50-90; current bid A$130 at 10 Nov. Google confirms: Intrepid Prince Regent is a cheap 1960s-70s English (K.P. Morritt / Gladding) fixed-spool reel; Fishcake is the US Helin Tackle Co. (Detroit) Fishcake surface lure; 'Ashley' is an old Tasmanian/Victorian trout lure name (Ashley Devon, later made by Tillins of Blackwall, West Tamar per Lure Hub OZ). Winged X-pattern lures are Tasmanian Devil type trout lures (Wigston's, New Norfolk); slim green/brown winged lures are Cobra-type Tassie wobblers. Daiwa box reads 'Fishing Reel 72x0' (Daiwa 7200-series, most likely 7270).
